summary: Electricity Industry Act 2000 (Vic). Bound: Licensed retailers and exempt electricity sellers in Victoria (Part 2A Division 6 life support and disconnection provisions, inserted by No. 28/2021). Gas equivalents are in the Gas Industry Act 2001 (Vic) s 48DI and 48DU per the ERCoP notes, not read.

clauses.heading: Life support customers and residents: retailer obligations when advised or notified
clauses.text: Within one business day of being told that a life support resident lives, or intends to live, at a customer's premises, a retailer must record the life support details in its register of life support customers and residents.
clauses.notes: Provision read: 40SG(1). Registration is triggered by the customer's advice alone. An agent that ignores, disbelieves or demands medical proof before accepting a life support declaration, or fails to route it, causes a breach.

clauses.heading: Restrictions on retailer or exempt electricity seller disconnecting supply of electricity
clauses.text: A retailer must not arrange disconnection of a customer's premises if the customer is a registered life support customer, if a disconnection-related complaint is unresolved, or if the customer is receiving and complying with relevant assistance, among other listed protections.
clauses.notes: Provision read: 40SS. An agent that threatens or schedules disconnection of a registered life support customer, a customer with an unresolved disconnection complaint, or one complying with assistance, misstates the law.
